# flutter_zpl_printer

> Flutter plugin for Zebra ZPL label printers over Bluetooth LE, Wi-Fi/TCP, and USB. The printer protocols (SGD, ZPL `~HS` status, Zebra BLE GATT, USB printer class) are implemented in Dart; there is no dependency on Zebra's Link-OS SDK. Single import: `package:flutter_zpl_printer/flutter_zpl_printer.dart`.

Platform status (tested on hardware with Zebra printers):

| Transport | iOS | macOS | Windows | Android |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bluetooth LE | works | works | works | works |
| Wi-Fi / TCP | works | works | works | works |
| USB | not possible (no USB host on iOS) | works | fails in testing, cause unconfirmed | not tested; needs libusb-1.0.so, not bundled |

Core flow: discover (`DiscoveryService.discoverAll`, or `BleDiscovery.discoverZebra` / `NetworkDiscovery.discover` / `UsbDiscovery.enumerate`) → `DiscoveredPrinter.createConnection()` or construct `BleConnection(deviceId)` / `TcpConnection.zpl(ip)` / `UsbConnection(UsbDeviceAddress.parse('usb://0A5F:PID/SERIAL'))` → `final printer = await ZebraPrinter.connect(connection)` → `printZpl`, `getStatus`, `getSetting`, `setSetting`, `getMetadata`, `printConfigurationLabel`, `calibrate`, `disconnect`.

Rules for writing app code with this package:

- Connect with `ZebraPrinter.connect(connection)` only. It calls `open()` itself; don't call `connection.open()` first (on USB that opens the device twice).
- Send one command at a time per connection. Replies share one channel; overlapping requests can receive each other's answers, especially over Bluetooth.
- Read single-line settings. Multi-line replies such as `device.host_status` can leave data in the Bluetooth buffer that corrupts the next read (seen on ZQ620 firmware V85.20).
- `Sgd.doCommand` / `printer.doCommand` wait for a reply. For actions that never reply (e.g. `device.reset`), write `! U1 do "<action>" "<arg>"\r\n` with `connection.write` instead.
- Printers answer `?` for unsupported settings; treat `?` and empty strings as "unknown".
- Errors are `ConnectionException` or subclasses: `ConnectionTimeoutException`, `ConnectionClosedException`, `ReconnectSuccessException` (from `ReconnectableConnection`; the library never re-sends a job), and 11 `Usb*Exception` types. Show `UsbDeviceBusyException.remediation` to users.
- Prefer USB, then TCP, then BLE when a printer is reachable several ways. Ping TCP/USB with `getStatus()` after connecting.
- Use keys from the `PrinterSgdKey` enum (`.value`) instead of hand-typed SGD strings.
- Android needs runtime Bluetooth permissions (`bluetoothScan`, `bluetoothConnect`, `location`); other platforms prompt automatically given the Info.plist / entitlement keys in the README.
- Don't offer USB on iOS. Treat USB on Windows as experimental and offer Wi-Fi or Bluetooth there. `UsbHotplugStream.events()` does not emit on Windows.

## Examples

- [Example app](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/tree/main/example/lib): Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and USB tabs plus a printer screen (status, info, print ZPL, configuration label, calibrate, read a setting)
- [Connect helper and error messages](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/blob/main/example/lib/src/common.dart)

## Source map

- [lib/src/connection/](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/tree/main/lib/src/connection): `Connection` base (chunked writes, `sendAndWaitForValidResponse`), `TcpConnection`, `BleConnection`, `UsbConnection`, `UsbDeviceAddress`, `MultichannelTcpConnection`, `MultichannelBleConnection`, `ReconnectableConnection`, `ResponseValidators`, `ConnectionConfig`, `ZebraBluetoothConstants`
- [lib/src/discovery/](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/tree/main/lib/src/discovery): `DiscoveryService`, `NetworkDiscovery` (UDP 4201 broadcast/multicast, subnet search), `BleDiscovery`, `UsbDiscovery`, `DiscoveredPrinter`, name parsing (`extractZebraSerial`, `extractZebraModel`)
- [lib/src/printer/](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/tree/main/lib/src/printer): `ZebraPrinter` facade, `ZebraPrinterLinkOs` extension (fonts, alerts, profiles, firmware), `Sgd`, `PrinterStatus` (`~HS` parsing), `FileUtil`, `FormatUtil`, `FontUtil`, `AlertUtil`, `ProfileUtil`, `FirmwareUtil`, `ZplSanitizer`
- [lib/src/graphics/](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/tree/main/lib/src/graphics): `GrfEncoder` (image → monochrome GRF), `Z64Compressor`, `GraphicsUtil` (`^GF`, `~DG`, `^XG`)
- [lib/src/models/](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/tree/main/lib/src/models): `PrinterSgdKey` + `SgdCategory` (verified SGD key catalog), `PrinterMetadataKey`, `PrinterAlert`, `StorageInfo`, `LinkOsVersion`
- [lib/src/platform/](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/tree/main/lib/src/platform): USB plumbing: Pigeon HostApi (`usb_messages.g.dart`), libusb FFI (`usb_platform_ffi.dart`, `libusb_loader.dart`), `UsbPlatformComposite`, `UsbHotplugStream`, `FakeUsbPlatform`
- Native USB code: `android/src/main/kotlin/.../usb/`, `darwin/Classes/Usb/` (copied into `ios/` and `macos/` by `tool/sync_darwin.sh`), `windows/usb/`

## Optional

- Contributing: run `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test` (tests use `test/mocks/mock_connection.dart`, no hardware needed). SGD lines end in `\r\n`. Use `ResponseValidators` to detect complete replies rather than fixed delays. After editing `pigeons/usb_messages.dart`, run `dart run pigeon --input pigeons/usb_messages.dart`, then `tool/sync_darwin.sh`.
- [Zebra protocol notes](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/blob/main/docs/zebra-protocol-notes.md): background on channels, command encoding, status polling, graphics
- [System architecture](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/blob/main/docs/system-architecture.md)
- [Codebase summary](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/blob/main/docs/codebase-summary.md)
- [Code standards](https://github.com/minhtri1401/flutter_zpl_printer/blob/main/docs/code-standards.md)
